mapper.select: INSERT INTO review_task (profile_id, question_id, due_at, status) VALUES (#{entity.profileId}, #{entity.questionId}, #{entity.dueAt}, 'PENDING') RETURNING id, profile_id AS "profileId", question_id AS "questionId", due_at AS "dueAt", status, created_at AS "createdAt", completed_at AS "completedAt"

SELECT r.id, q.id AS "questionId", q.title, q.star_level AS "starLevel", r.due_at AS "dueAt", r.status FROM review_task r JOIN question q ON q.id = r.question_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.status = #{status} AND q.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY r.due_at ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT r.id, q.id AS "questionId", q.title, q.star_level AS "starLevel", r.due_at AS "dueAt", r.status FROM review_task r JOIN question q ON q.id = r.question_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND q.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.due_at >= #{start} AND r.due_at < #{end} ORDER BY r.due_at ASC, r.id ASC
